intro.text: Scion Unoqua, the religious leader of Prime Aqasix Yanagawn's court in Azir.

items.text: Unoqua was aboard the ship carrying Yanagawn away from Thaylen City before the battle there. With Noura and Dalksi he urged Yanagawn not to turn back on Lift's word, insisting that Yaezir had chosen him to rule. He feared the Radiants' powers and worried about the warnings of the Eila Stele.

appearance.text: An old man with a full paunch.

personality.text: He holds a deep reverence for Yaezir and Azir's religious customs.
